summary: This directory provides unit testing utilities and validation logic for resolving and normalizing module specifiers and source paths within the codebase analysis pipeline.
responsibilities: Verify the correctness of module specifier resolution
Ensure source paths are consistently normalized
Provide testing suites for file path and import module mappings
relationships: Module specifiers are mapped to source paths to track dependency relationships.
Normalization routines ensure that various module specifier formats map correctly to a single canonical source path.
designDecisions: Centralized testing of path resolution logic
Isolation of dependency analysis utilities from core business logic
